Bug_Title: Eq: equals() method defined that doesn’t override Object.equals(Object) (EQ_OTHER_USE_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines an equals()
method, that doesn't override the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class. 
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The class BuggyEqualsMethod defines an equals() method that takes a parameter of type BuggyEqualsMethod, but does not override the equals(Object) method from the base java.lang.Object class. This results in unexpected behavior when comparing objects of this class with objects of type Object.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case compares an instance of BuggyEqualsMethod with an instance of Object using the equals method. Since BuggyEqualsMethod does not override Object.equals(Object), it behaves unexpectedly, causing the test case to fail.
